verdict.rationale: Notte is built for headless, programmatic operation. Sessions are cloud browser instances controlled programmatically via a Bearer-token API, a CLI, and a CDP/Playwright endpoint. Scripts can also be deployed as serverless functions that you invoke and schedule anywhere, which fits CI and automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI-specific documentation (e.g. a GitHub Actions or pipeline guide) and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
